name: B10-0022/2024 (PPE) – The case of José Daniel Ferrier García in Cuba
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Cuba to release José Daniel Ferrer García and all other people held for their political views. It says he has been held in isolation and without contact since 2021, and that his health is reported to be critical. It condemns torture and poor treatment of prisoners and asks for independent investigations and medical care. It also asks European Union countries to sanction senior Cuban officials, starting with Miguel Díaz-Canel, and to lift the cooperation agreement with Cuba.

- The text asks for prisoners' release and sanctions on Cuban officials; it changes no law itself.
- It affects José Daniel Ferrer, other political prisoners and senior Cuban officials.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to Cuba, the European Union and international bodies.
